# IMessageAdapter
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/chain-bridge/src/interfaces/IMessageAdapter.sol)

**Title:**
IMessageAdapter

Interface for bridge adapters that can send messages and read state across chains

This interface defines methods for messaging and read operations only


## Functions
### readState

Read state from a contract on a source chain

Initiates a cross-chain state read operation


```solidity
function readState(
    bytes32 operationId,
    BridgeTypes.ExecuteReadStateParams calldata params,
    BridgeTypes.BridgeOptions calldata options
)
    external
    payable;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`operationId`|`bytes32`|Router-provided operation ID for tracking|
|`params`|`BridgeTypes.ExecuteReadStateParams`|Parameters for the read state operation|
|`options`|`BridgeTypes.BridgeOptions`|Bridge options including adapter selection and parameters|


### sendMessage

Send a general message to a destination chain

Initiates a cross-chain messaging operation


```solidity
function sendMessage(
    bytes32 operationId,
    BridgeTypes.ExecuteSendMessageParams calldata params,
    BridgeTypes.BridgeOptions calldata options
)
    external
    payable;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`operationId`|`bytes32`|Router-provided operation ID for tracking|
|`params`|`BridgeTypes.ExecuteSendMessageParams`|Parameters for the send message operation|
|`options`|`BridgeTypes.BridgeOptions`|Bridge options including adapter selection and parameters|


### supportsMessageOperation

Check if the adapter supports a specific message operation type to a destination


```solidity
function supportsMessageOperation(
    uint16 destinationChainId,
    BridgeTypes.OperationType operationType
)
    external
    view
    returns (bool);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`destinationChainId`|`uint16`|ID of the destination chain|
|`operationType`|`BridgeTypes.OperationType`|Type of operation (MESSAGE or READ_STATE)|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bool`|Whether the operation is supported|


## Events
### MessageInitiated
Emitted when a message is initiated through the adapter


```solidity
event MessageInitiated(bytes32 indexed messageId, uint16 destinationChainId, address recipient, bytes message);
```

### ReadRequestInitiated
Emitted when a read request is initiated through the adapter


```solidity
event ReadRequestInitiated(
    bytes32 indexed requestId,
    uint16 srcChainId,
    uint16 destinationChainId,
    address destinationContract,
    bytes4 selector
);
```

### ReadOperationNotFound
Emitted when a read operation is not found through the adapter


```solidity
event ReadOperationNotFound(bytes32 indexed guid, string reason);
```

### MessageDelivered
Emitted when a message is delivered through the adapter


```solidity
event MessageDelivered(bytes32 indexed messageId, address recipient, bool delivered);
```

### ReadResponseDelivered
Emitted when a read response is delivered through the adapter


```solidity
event ReadResponseDelivered(bytes32 indexed requestId, bytes response);
```

## Errors
### MessageFailed
Thrown when a message operation fails


```solidity
error MessageFailed();
```

### ReadFailed
Thrown when a read operation fails


```solidity
error ReadFailed();
```
